content: this is a summary of a civil case heard in the šiauliai district court the court decided to dissolve the marriage between the applicant identified as o ž and the defendant identified as p ž the court divided the matrimonial property with each party receiving a share of an apartment basement an outbuilding and two cars the court also recognized the debts owed by the defendant to various creditors the court ordered the defendant to pay stamp duty court fees professional fees and additional stamp duty the court upheld the claims of the applicant and ordered the defendant to pay certain fines and expenses the defendant is also required to pay the applicant for the costs of the proceedings
